The figure (books/heap-store-figure.lisp fn-heap-store-figure-octets) and the owner's protected allowance (fn-heap-runtime-protected-octets, via fn-prstartup-protected) both include fn-heap-core-dynamic = the CALLING process's sb-kernel:dynamic-usage (host/native/heap.lisp fnn-heap-image-observation): the probe process's usage sizes the figure, the owner's own (larger, by ~17 MB) is checked against it, with no slack between them.
